<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1297629_confer_0.Create Conference Processor</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>true</mobile_callable><name>Create Conference Processor</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CreateConferenceProcessor = Class.create();
CreateConferenceProcessor.prototype = {
  // Extend AbstractAjaxProcessor to make the Script Include callable via GlideAjax
  initialize: function() {
    // Constructor logic if necessary
  },

  // Process the incoming request
  processRequest: function() {
    var action = this.getParameter('sys_id');  // Action from the client-side
    var conferenceData = this.getParameter('conferenceData');  // The JSON string with form data

    // Check the action and call the appropriate method
    if (action === 'createConference') {
      return this.createConference(JSON.parse(conferenceData));  // Parse and process the data
    }

    return "Invalid Action";  // Default response if action is not recognized
  },

  // Create the conference record
  createConference: function(conferenceRecord) {
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_1297629_confer_0_conferences');  // Your custom table
    gr.initialize();

    gr.name = conferenceRecord.name;
    gr.location = conferenceRecord.location;

    // Convert the dates from string to GlideDateTime
    var startDate = new GlideDateTime(conferenceRecord.start_date);  // Parse the ISO string into GlideDateTime
    var endDate = new GlideDateTime(conferenceRecord.end_date);

    gr.start_date = startDate;
    gr.end_date = endDate;

    gr.manager = conferenceRecord.manager;
    gr.subject = conferenceRecord.subject;

    // Insert the new record and return the record ID
    var recordID = gr.insert();
    return recordID ? recordID : "Error in record creation";
  }
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-04-05 18:11:17</sys_created_on><sys_id>9d319c2c83f4ea100c1eb3a6feaad35a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Create Conference Processor</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Conference Management" source="x_1297629_confer_0">463ae88383bb12100c1eb3a6feaad383</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Conference Management">463ae88383bb12100c1eb3a6feaad383</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_9d319c2c83f4ea100c1eb3a6feaad35a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-04-05 18:39:48</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
